versions.content: If pending CanIf Tx L-PDUs or Transmit Requests are available in the CanIfTxBuffers as per [SWS_CANIF_00386], then CanIf shall call Can_Write() for that pending CanIf Tx L-PDU or Transmit Requests (of the one assigned to the new Hardware Transmit Object ) with the highest priority (see [SWS_CANIF_00070]).
